description: Read the status of a site database export: running, ready, failed or expired. While it runs, the call waits up to about 15 seconds for the file. An export that nobody reads for a minute stops, so call this again after pollAfterSeconds. The file is not part of the result. When the status is ready, download it with `ship sites export-db <SITE_ID> --export <EXPORT_ID>`, or from GET /v1/sites/{siteId}/database/exports/{exportId}/file.
name: get_site_database_export

status.description: `running` until the file is made. `ready` while the file can be downloaded. `expired` after `expiresAt`: start a new export. `failed` gives the cause in `failure`.

title: Get site database export
